numeric_reconstruction.scope: numeric reconstruction and physical-mode budget only; RTL and synthesis/PNR still required

contract.clocks: Original clk50 50MHz and rgmii_rxc 100MHz; no clock/reset/CDC change
contract.port: Single clk; independent we/waddr12/wdata36 and re/raddr12; registered rdata36. No reset port.
contract.read: At rising clk with re=1, sample old mem[raddr]; one clock read latency. Selected-bank state changes on the same edge, with no added consumer wait state.
contract.hold: re=0 holds selected bank and every per-bank read q, hence public rdata even while writes occur or addresses change.
contract.read_first: RTL uses nonblocking writes and a separate enabled read process, so same-address simultaneous read/write returns pre-write data, then the next enabled read sees the new word.
contract.initialization: INIT_FILE empty branch only. Every memory bit comes from INIT_VAL (low18/high18); each qr and selector initialize0 exactly as old source. Production INIT_VAL=0; nonzero36bit initialization is also in the prepared test.
contract.storage: Old8x512x36 banks -> four groups of1024x(low18,high18), eight1024x18 leaves; full address/data capacity unchanged.
contract.caller: slf_extract writes monotonically to pb_waddr=n_pts[11:0] while n_pts<4096; slf_match reads j[11:0] via S_T0/S_T0W/S_T1. No explicit top-level no-overlap gate exists: mt_frame_en does not include !mt_busy, so this review does not assume read/write exclusion.
contract.collision_scope: Same-clock read-first is exercised in the prepared RTL test, including all4096 exact collisions. Old vendor-model evidence supports the old branch, but stage3 must independently inspect actual SDP modes; electrical collision behavior is not proven by source alone.
contract.reuse: Exact old point-plane BRANCH reused; old source active banked body differs from SYN40 only by syn_maxfan attribute. Old RTL+vendor28682checks/4098collisions/nonzeroINIT and physical16->8 were isolated in a different joint context. Fallback row/ROM branches are not imported.
